hotels.title: Maldives Pool Villas with Daily Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner + Roundtrip Seaplane Transfers
hotels.description: Known for scene-setting stays from New York to Miami and London, The Standard brings its signature playful edge to island life, swapping city skylines for endless blue horizons. Experience the brand’s take on paradise, where every villa comes with its own plunge pool and playful design details bring disco-ball sparkle to the tropics. Of course, the quintessential Maldives touches are there too: a scenic seaplane ride takes you to private pool villas set by the sand or over the lagoon. Wander from the beach into crystal-clear shallows or step straight from your overwater deck into a living lagoon, where tropical fish, coral gardens and seasonal manta ray encounters bring the house reef to life. Between snorkels, slow things down at The Standard Spa with indulgent treatments, a hammam and scheduled yoga sessions. Six dining venues ensure there’s always something worth coming ashore for, from Guduguda’s Maldivian plates and Kula’s live cooking stations to oceanfront Mediterranean flavours at Onda. At BBQ Shak, fresh seafood is grilled over coconut-shell charcoal, while Todis Bar keeps cocktails flowing and Joos Cafe handles the poolside pick-me-ups.
